feeding_claim.verbatim: Our beef is home raised on quality pasture grass and grain finished.

notes: Fourth-generation family farm and ranch of Lloyd and Clara (surname not given beyond the brand); site mentions both Ada, KS and a Minneapolis, KS 67467 address (505 Limestone Rd., Ottawa County). Read homepage, about, collections, contact information policy page and a ground beef product page (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote). Homepage says cattle graze native grass, cover crops and stalks in winter; about page says calves receive a feed ration that includes grain, formulated with a nutritionist, and they raise their own alfalfa, brome and silage. Collections page: 'Our Orders are for Local Pickup & Delivery Only - We do not offer shipping at this time', delivery within 40 miles of Minneapolis (lists nearby towns, not captured), farther customers asked to text first; $50 minimum for delivery. Pickup location not stated (assumed farm, verify). Whole, half and quarter sides offered; beef bundles currently not offered. Resolves the leads.md lead.
